description: Java class 'SimpleWikiHelper' providing methods to interact with a lightweight Wiktionary API, including fetching page content and preparing user agent strings.

classes.name: SimpleWikiHelper
classes.description: Helper class for interacting with Wiktionary API, including fetching page content and setting user agent.

methods.name: prepareUserAgent
methods.description: Initializes the user agent string based on app package name and version.

methods.name: getPageContent
methods.description: Fetches and returns the content of a specified Wiktionary page, optionally expanding templates.

methods.name: getUrlContent
methods.description: Retrieves raw content from a specified URL, synchronized due to shared buffer usage.
